The '''Adrenal Research Base''' was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientific]] research compound maintained by the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]], studying how to reproduce [[venenit queshaaga]], or Quesh venom. Around [[3642 BBY]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] attacked the facility, forcing the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] to defend it with the help of the [[Eighty-sixth Infantry|86th Infantry]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Sajar]].
